title: compareTemplateVersions response
description: compareTemplateVersions - responses per status code. Existing synchronous template comparator ('fast and reliable', E-26) returning the diff between two template versions.
$comment: Source: DISENO S2 (d) TemplateDiffPort (comparator, ACL), (h) TimeLimiter(T_api) -> CircuitBreaker(template-comparator) -> Retry(N_reint); DISENO 4.8 SX-05; ADR-020 SX-05; E-26; DISENO 5.2. Audience: CONSUMED CONTRACT (external system, client-side expectation) - SX-05 (S2 -> existing comparator). Residency: GLOBAL (home region); template content only (TEMPLATE_PUBLIC). Idempotency: safe read. Pagination: n/a. CONSUMED CONTRACT: owned by an external team; method, path, authentication and error bodies are NOT defined by the documents and are not designed here. Fallback: ChangeSummaryFailed.v1 + deferred retry.
